info.name: jungle-test
info.description: Scenarios of the technical test. Import together with jungle-test-localhost.postman_environment.json (edit api1, api2, api3 and keycloak to point at another host) and run the whole collection with the Collection Runner, in order. Tokens are obtained automatically from Keycloak.

exec: // Obtains and caches client_credentials tokens from Keycloak for every request.
if (err || res.code !== 200) { console.error("token for " + client + " failed", err || res.text()); return; }
setTimeout(() => {}, 5000); // the provider-a-shortlived client issues 3 s tokens
